# 快速上手

首次使用时引导完成设置的页面：Page 中用 Progress 显示已完成的步骤，Panel 中每个 ListItem 是一步，带各自的操作按钮，执行时显示 `loading`，完成后变成「Done」Pill。全部完成后，用成功的 Alert 代替进度。下方的 Grid 中是指向帮助的 Panel。

**难度**：入门　**用到的组件**：[Alert](../components/Alert.md), [Button](../components/Button.md), [Grid](../components/Grid.md), [Icon](../components/Icon.md), [Inline](../components/Inline.md), [LinkButton](../components/LinkButton.md), [ListItem](../components/ListItem.md), [Page](../components/Page.md), [Panel](../components/Panel.md), [Pill](../components/Pill.md), [Progress](../components/Progress.md), [Stack](../components/Stack.md), [Text](../components/Text.md)

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import {
  Alert,
  Button,
  Grid,
  Icon,
  type IconName,
  Inline,
  LinkButton,
  ListItem,
  Page,
  Panel,
  Pill,
  Progress,
  Stack,
  Text,
} from 'vellum-ui'

interface SetupStep {
  readonly id: string
  readonly title: string
  readonly description: string
  /** The text of the button that does the step. */
  readonly action: string
  readonly done: boolean
}

const STEPS: readonly SetupStep[] = [
  {
    id: 'workspace',
    title: 'Create your workspace',
    description: 'Name it and choose who can join.',
    action: 'Create',
    done: true,
  },
  {
    id: 'invite',
    title: 'Invite your team',
    description: 'People you invite get an email with a link.',
    action: 'Invite people',
    done: false,
  },
  {
    id: 'import',
    title: 'Import your projects',
    description: 'From a spreadsheet, or from another tool.',
    action: 'Import',
    done: false,
  },
  {
    id: 'notify',
    title: 'Choose your notifications',
    description: 'Decide what reaches you by email and on your phone.',
    action: 'Open settings',
    done: false,
  },
]

interface Resource {
  readonly id: string
  readonly icon: IconName
  readonly title: string
  readonly description: string
}

const RESOURCES: readonly Resource[] = [
  { id: 'guides', icon: 'book', title: 'Guides', description: 'Short articles on the main tasks.' },
  {
    id: 'shortcuts',
    icon: 'command',
    title: 'Shortcuts',
    description: 'Press Ctrl K anywhere to search.',
  },
  {
    id: 'support',
    icon: 'message',
    title: 'Ask us',
    description: 'We answer within one working day.',
  },
]

function openHelp(id: string) {
  window.location.hash = `#/help/${id}`
}

const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms))

export function GettingStarted() {
  const [steps, setSteps] = useState(STEPS)
  // The step whose action is running: one at a time, like a real setup
  const [running, setRunning] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const done = steps.filter((s) => s.done).length
  const finished = done === steps.length

  const run = async (id: string) => {
    setRunning(id)
    // A real page opens the dialog or the page of the step here; the recipe only waits
    await wait(600)
    setSteps((list) => list.map((s) => (s.id === id ? { ...s, done: true } : s)))
    setRunning(null)
  }

  return (
    <Page
      width="narrow"
      title="Welcome to Northwind"
      subtitle="A few steps to get your team going. You can come back to them at any time."
      actions={
        finished ? undefined : (
          <Button variant="text" onClick={() => setSteps(STEPS)}>
            Start over
          </Button>
        )
      }
    >
      <Stack gap={5}>
        {finished ? (
          <Alert
            tone="success"
            showIcon
            title="You are all set"
            description="Your workspace is ready. Open your projects to start working."
          />
        ) : (
          <Stack gap={2}>
            <Inline justify="between">
              <Text weight="semibold">Set up your workspace</Text>
              <Text tone="secondary" size="sm" numeric>
                {done} of {steps.length} done
              </Text>
            </Inline>
            <Progress
              percent={(done / steps.length) * 100}
              showValue={false}
              size="sm"
              aria-label="Setup"
            />
          </Stack>
        )}

        <Panel flush>
          <Stack gap={1} padding={2}>
            {steps.map((step) => (
              <ListItem
                key={step.id}
                leading={
                  <Icon
                    name={step.done ? 'check-circle' : 'circle-dashed'}
                    size={20}
                    tone={step.done ? 'success' : 'tertiary'}
                  />
                }
                title={step.title}
                description={step.description}
                actions={
                  step.done ? (
                    <Pill tone="success">Done</Pill>
                  ) : (
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      loading={running === step.id}
                      disabled={running !== null && running !== step.id}
                      onClick={() => run(step.id)}
                    >
                      {step.action}
                    </Button>
                  )
                }
              />
            ))}
          </Stack>
        </Panel>

        <Stack gap={3}>
          <Text weight="semibold">Learn more</Text>
          <Grid columns={3}>
            {RESOURCES.map((r) => (
              <Panel key={r.id}>
                <Stack gap={2} align="start">
                  <Icon name={r.icon} size={20} tone="accent" />
                  <Text weight="semibold">{r.title}</Text>
                  <Text tone="secondary" size="sm">
                    {r.description}
                  </Text>
                  <LinkButton icon="arrow-right" onClick={() => openHelp(r.id)}>
                    Open
                  </LinkButton>
                </Stack>
              </Panel>
            ))}
          </Grid>
        </Stack>
      </Stack>
    </Page>
  )
}
```
